title: Mahjong Slide & Pair
description: No hand-counting required — shove whole rows and columns of classic tiles until twins collide, snap pairs off the emerald felt, and clear the table.
controls: Tap adjacent matching tiles to clear them, or slide any row/column to line up pairs. Use Hint or Shuffle anytime.

zh-CN.title: 雀神推牌对对消
zh-CN.description: 不用凑番也能当雀神！整行整列「哗啦」一推，把两张相同的萬、筒、條、红中推到面对面直接碰走，节奏丝滑到根本停不下来。
zh-CN.controls: 相邻同牌直接点掉，隔得远就拖住整行或整列推过去对齐；眼花时随时点「提示」或「洗牌」翻盘！
